children: Argan is boosting its quarterly dividend by 40% to 70 cents a share, up from 50 cents.
The new payout, equal to $2.80 a year, represents a 0.7% annual yield based on the company's Wednesday closing price of $402.13.
The dividend will be paid on Oct. 30 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 22.
The increase is Argan's fourth annual consecutive boost to its dividend, Chief Executive David Watson said.
